title: "The system cannot find the path specified…..\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python313\python.exe] was unexpected at this time" pyspark in command line
question:
I set up spark in my windows system. Post this, I could run pyspark command in command line which worked perfectly 2 days back. But, now surprisingly I get this error:

Below are the environment variables

  • HADOOP_HOME = C:\Program Files\hadoop-3.3.6

  • JAVA_HOME = C:\Program Files\Java\jdk-11.0.0.2

  • PYSPARK_DRIVER_PYTHON = C:\Users\Gagana H\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python313\python.exe

  • PYSPARK_PYTHON = C:\Users\Gagana H\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python313\python.exe

  • PYTHONPATH = C:\Program Files\spark-3.5.5\python and C:\Program Files\spark-3.5.5\python

  • SPARK_HOME = C:\Program Files\spark-3.5.5

  • PATH:

Based on few suggestions in stackoverflow I did see if there is python executable file in AppData folder - and it is indeed present. Unable to figure out the issue as to how it stopped working.

Note: The only thing I did after setting up JDK, Hadoop, Python and Spark is that I installed pycharm. Does this cause any issue?
answer:
The issue looks like it's coming from the space(s) in your paths. I would recommend reinstalling python to C:\python and changing your PYSPARK_DRIVER_PYTHON, PYSPARK_PYTHON, and PYTHON_PATH environment variables to point to the new install location.

You also need to install pyspark to a location without spaces.
